1.7.8.en: Renamed the app to "EcoFlow - Stream Systems" to better reflect its focus on the STREAM range.

1.7.7.en: New app icon using the EcoFlow EF monogram, replacing the previous sun-and-battery icon.

1.7.6.en: Updated the App Store image to a real-life photo of the STREAM battery and balcony solar panels at home.

1.7.5.en: New App Store image showing the STREAM battery and solar panels on a white background.

1.7.4.en: Real product photos for STREAM Battery, STREAM Unit, STREAM Solar and Smart Plug device images (on a white background).

1.7.3.en: STREAM Unit icon redrawn as a clean outline so it no longer appears as a solid black shape on the device tile.

1.7.2.en: New device-specific icons for STREAM Battery, STREAM Solar and Smart Plug. Removed the PowerStream device, which is not offered by this app.

1.7.1.en: Fix: existing STREAM Ultra X units now correctly gain their solar PV input tiles (previously only brand-new pairings showed them).

1.7.0.en: STREAM Unit devices are now fully controllable, tailored to each model and its role. Every unit gains AC output 1/2 switches and AC output power; the system main unit also gains the whole-home controls and flow tiles (operating mode, backup reserve, charge/discharge limits, grid feed-in, house consumption and the house power split). Solar models (e.g. STREAM Ultra X) show their PV inputs; AC-coupled models (e.g. STREAM AC Pro) hide the solar tiles they cannot report.

1.6.9.en: New STREAM Unit icon: the device icon and images now show the STREAM unit itself (3D enclosure with its front display panel and side cooling fins) instead of a generic battery, so the 6 physical STREAM units are easier to recognise at a glance.

1.6.8.en: STREAM Unit devices are now tailored to their exact model. Each unit's Settings page shows its model, serial number, role in the system and energy source, and AC-coupled units (e.g. STREAM AC Pro) no longer show solar (PV) tiles they cannot report. STREAM Battery, Solar and Microinverter devices are unchanged.

1.6.0.en: Polished for the Homey App Store: refreshed app and device icons (full-canvas, each device now has its own unique icon), new lively app artwork and clean white-background device images, plus a tidier app name and description. No changes to how your devices work.

1.5.0.en: Per-unit detail like the EcoFlow app: each STREAM Unit now shows its own solar (PV1–4) and time-to-full/empty. The STREAM Microinverter is now supported as a solar device (PV1/PV2 + generated energy + grid feed).

1.4.0.en: Internal hardening: a shared device foundation reduces duplicated code, the realtime (MQTT) connection now recovers from certificate expiry with backoff and survives credential changes without losing updates, and the energy widget now shows today's solar. No changes to how your devices work.

1.3.1.en: Reliability fixes from a multi-model code review: prevents duplicate MQTT sessions, stops energy meters double-counting under concurrent updates, keeps cumulative meters monotonic when switching the meter mode, fixes the 'charging started' flow trigger after idle, avoids offline/online flapping, and cleans up the MQTT connection on app shutdown.

1.3.0.en: New 'STREAM Energy Flow' dashboard widget showing the live EcoFlow-style picture — Grid, Solar, Home and Battery (with % and charge state) in kW, refreshing every few seconds.

1.2.0.en: New EcoFlow-style icons and graphics throughout, including a clearer electricity-meter icon. Each AC socket on STREAM AC Pro / Ultra X is now its own smart-plug device (on/off + live power). The Smart Meter can show either Grid power or total Home load (device settings), adds live Grid import / Grid export tiles, and updates faster.

1.1.0.en: Full Homey Energy integration: STREAM is now a proper home battery (charged/discharged meters), with a new STREAM Solar device and the Smart Meter as a grid meter. Fixes discovery of all STREAM models (Ultra X, AC Pro, etc.). Configure your EcoFlow keys once — pairing more devices no longer re-asks. Adds settable charge/discharge limits, fault alarms, and richer realtime data over MQTT.

1.0.0.en: Initial release: EcoFlow STREAM monitoring & control (battery, solar, grid, AC outputs, backup reserve, operating mode, feed-in), Smart Meter (per-phase power/voltage/current + energy), Homey Energy integration, Flow cards and Insights, with realtime MQTT updates.

1.6.1.en: Polished for the Homey App Store: refreshed full-canvas app and device icons (each device now unique), lively new app artwork, clean white-background device images, and a tidier name and description. No changes to device behaviour.

1.6.2.en: Improves the STREAM and STREAM Unit device views with clearer energy-flow labels, better capability ordering, and per-unit battery-flow status.

1.6.3.en: Clarifies the STREAM Solar device as a whole-system solar aggregate and removes misleading per-unit PV input tiles from that aggregate view.

1.6.4.en: Adds STREAM Solar settings that explain the aggregate source and list each STREAM unit's PV inputs contributing to the system solar total.

1.6.5.en: Refreshes the EcoFlow driver icons and device images so each STREAM-related device is easier to recognise in Homey.

1.6.6.en: Updates the STREAM Microinverter and Smart Meter driver images to match the real EcoFlow devices more closely.

1.6.7.en: Updates the STREAM battery driver icons and images so the battery devices are easier to recognise in Homey.

1.7.9.en: App icon now shows the white EcoFlow monogram on a black background.

1.7.10.en: Renamed the app to "EcoFlow STREAM Series".

1.8.0.en: Accurate per-model solar inputs, smarter energy tiles, new Octopus-style tariff Flow actions (cheap-charge / peak-export), a battery-level condition, and AC-output info.

1.8.1.en: Improve Homey device tile icons for STREAM capability status and controls.

1.8.2.en: Add STREAM dashboard widgets and improve Smart Meter and Microinverter live icons/status indicators.

1.8.3.en: Harden API security, realtime reliability, energy accounting, Flows, widgets, and CI.

1.8.4.en: Improve STREAM device icons, model identification, and Home Battery pairing.

1.8.5.en: Add support for optional PayPal donations through Homey's native Donate button.

1.8.6.en: Extend the backup reserve control to 100% and improve App Store search tags.

1.9.0.en: Five dashboard widgets each now have their own accurate preview. Safer backup-reserve control fixes a case where changes could silently fail. Energy meters stay accurate across restarts and a sturdier realtime connection. New tariff/grid Flow cards. STREAM Max solar-input correction.

1.10.0.en: German and Dutch translations. New: a real solar forecast (today and tomorrow) from your local weather, plus tariff-aware Flows that work with any electricity-price app (Octopus, Tibber, aWATTar and more). Sturdier connectivity and more reliable widgets.

1.10.1.en: Better App Store discoverability with more search tags, now also in German and Dutch.

1.10.2.en: Adds the Homey Community support link and German and Dutch App Store descriptions.

1.10.3.en: Rebuilt all five widget preview pairs as text-free, transparent artwork that follows the Homey Widget Preview guidelines.

1.10.4.en: Adds experimental monitoring-only STREAM AC 5000 support. Improves STREAM Home Battery widgets with aggregate-only selection, configurable capacity, stored/usable kWh, and more accurate runtime estimates. Includes reliability and security updates.

1.10.5.en: Updated the STREAM AC 5000 driver icon and app store images.

1.10.6.en: Prevents unsupported STREAM devices from polling or accepting controls through the Developer API, improves dedicated-driver guidance, and clarifies the monitoring-only STREAM AC 5000 connection.

1.10.7.en: Improved STREAM AC 5000 battery percentage, Homey Energy integration, telemetry resilience, and diagnostics.

1.10.8.en: Add a durable STREAM 5000 Series Unit driver with verified STREAM AC 5000 support, preserving existing devices through the legacy compatibility driver.

1.10.9.en: Adds Homey-recommended cumulative charged and discharged energy tracking for STREAM 5000 Series and AC 5000 devices, with persistent totals, restart safety, and stale-data protection.

1.10.10.en: Added a dedicated STREAM Home Battery for 5000-series installations, kept physical 5000 units as separate monitors to prevent duplicate Homey Energy accounting, expanded Energy Flow and Battery Plan widget support, and improved pairing and migration guidance.

1.10.11.en: Corrected the Homey Store descriptions for the new STREAM 5000 installation Home Battery and optional physical-monitor roles.

1.10.12.en: Added opt-in STREAM 5000 beta pairing with unsupported-API warnings, Beta-labelled devices, cumulative charged/discharged unit meters, and guidance to prevent duplicate Homey Energy totals.

1.10.13.en: Added standalone STREAM Unit Homey Energy support with individual live power, charged/discharged meters, and safe aggregate widget filtering.
